tips.text: Go solo, rush the captain, check the drop, and abort if nothing drops; the fighter and crewship objectives do not matter.
Pick the node your Railjack can handle; Kasio's Rest always has a commander, while Korm's Belt has easy enemies but only sometimes spawns a Galleon, so abort at load-in if there is no captain.
Bring Loki or Ivara so you can walk straight to the target; Ivara's sleep arrows set up a stealth finisher.
Park the Railjack about 8 km away before boarding so fighters lose aggro.
Skip loot abilities like Desecrate and Pilfering Swarm; they do not work on these targets.
Finish the mission once the blueprint drops; reports disagree on whether leaving keeps it.
Expect about one Intrinsic point per captain kill, so the farm also builds toward the Rank 7 gate for Flexa.
Expect RNG streaks; reports run from under 10 attempts to 50 kills, and it is still one of the easier Railjack farms.
